name: Acid
description: Exclusive paint awarded to players who have achieved great victories in eSports. This paint is given to winners of the «Major Rankings III» tournament.
interestingFacts: Players who receive this paint will also receive a unique Spectrum B module with  20% protection against all turrets and mines.
The paint was released in June 2011 and initially had the protection of 15% against all turrets.
The creator of this paint is Mikle777.
Previously, Acid was given to the winners of the {GAME_NAME} Fighting (TOF) tournaments.
By the summer of 2012, Acid gained the protection of 20% against all turrets.
From November 21, 2013 (Update #193), Acid's protection changed again to 18% against all turrets.
Following the winter season of the Top League, 2013-2014, the top eight clans received the paint.
At the transition of e-sports competitions to StarLadder, the paint was given for 4-8 places in the Star Series.
With the release of new protective paints on January 29 and February 6, 2015, the paint acquired protection from Hammer, Vulcan, and mines.
In July 2015, the paint was issued for first place in the tournament SLTV Hardstyle.
Paint was also owned by three prize-winners of Tanks in the city.
On July 14, 2016, the paint lost its protections due to the Paint Separation Update.
The paint was given to the winners of {GAME}Sport Season 3 - Team Pointers.
